run_interpreter_graph: run an FX graph module node-by-node with concrete tensor inputs and return the result
run_boxed_interpreter: run a graph module via the boxed calling convention for prompt tensor deallocation
transform_graph_module: transform a GraphModule symbolically and return a new transformed GraphModule
override_call_function: override Interpreter.call_function to swap or redirect function calls during graph execution
override_call_method: override Interpreter.call_method to swap or redirect method calls during graph execution
